judge: Two judges, each a Claude agent shown only the match sheet's claims and truth, not which method made the claims, ruled on every claim without seeing each other's rulings. An adjudicating agent ruled on each claim where they differed. Rules: the same problem at the same place; a general claim states nothing; when unsure, no match.

matches.note: Says the set has no code summary. No truth item covers a missing code summary.

Says the set has no door schedule, which is one clause of J10 almost word for word, at the same set-level place. It leaves out J10's missing door tags but names the same problem: door data cannot be checked. J10 is not_a_defect, but rule 7 says to map it anyway.
Says the set has no life safety plan. No truth item covers a missing life safety plan.
Says the set has no site plan. No truth item covers a missing site plan.
Says the tool did not compare exits and no occupant load is printed. No truth item covers occupant load or exit counts, and no discrepancy is named at a place.

Says the printed scale on A-101 (first floor) disagrees with the 162'-0" dimension. J37 covers A-101 and is this same problem: drawings do not measure at their stated scale. The claim's ratio is about 0.58, not exactly half, but that is a measurement difference, not a different defect. The point that travel distance could not be measured matches nothing on its own.

Gives a travel distance (at least 90.5 ft to Stair C on A-102) but names no defect. No truth item covers travel distance. This is not J38 (Stair 1 discharge) or J40 (corridor ends with no wall or door).

Gives the same scale disagreement as A-06 on A-101 (the 162'-0" dimension does not match the printed scale), so it states J37 too. Rule 4 allows two claims to state one item. The point that corridor width could not be measured matches nothing on its own.

Says the tool could not get a corridor width from the walls on the second floor. That is a tool limit, not a defect, and no corridor is named. It is not J40, which is about corridor ends with no wall or door across the opening.
Says no sheet index was found. No truth item covers a missing sheet index.
Says the tool could not read the title or number of A-202. No truth item covers A-202's title. J19 applies only to A-101 and A-102, and the claim does not say placeholders were left blank (J25).
Says the tool could not read the finish schedule crop on I-601. It names no row or discrepancy in the schedule.
Repeats A-01: no code sheet in the set. No truth item covers it.
Says no life safety sheet was found, so exit capacity could not be checked. No truth item covers a missing life safety sheet or exit capacity.
